leadText: The S.S. Prime Treasure (Japanese: プライム・トレジャー Prime Treasure) is a luxury cruise ship in the game . It is visiting Ryme City to observe the annual Pokémon Carnival. Most of Chapter 8 takes place here.
plainText:
The S.S. Prime Treasure (Japanese: プライム・トレジャー Prime Treasure) is a luxury cruise ship in the game . It is visiting Ryme City to observe the annual Pokémon Carnival. Most of Chapter 8 takes place here.

==Pokémon==
 

==Trivia==
The Ninetales encountered on the ship is referenced in the book Detective Pikachu: Episode 0—Eevee's Case, where Eevee states that it was chosen to go on a cruise with their owner.
